# TW-Blocks Design System

## Overview
TW-Blocks is a semantic spacing system for Tailwind CSS v4 based on blocks and tabs.

## For AI Coding Assistants
Install the skill: npx skills add vercel-labs/tw-blocks

## For Manual Installation
pnpm add tw-blocks

## Documentation
- Getting Started: /docs/getting-started
- Installation: /docs/installation
- API Reference: /docs/api
- Examples: /examples
- Skill File: /SKILLS/tw-blocks/SKILL.md

## Key Concepts
- Block unit: Component sizes (default 32px / 2rem)
- Tab unit: Padding/spacing (default 4px / 0.25rem)
- 4:1 Ratio: 4 tabs = 1 block for harmonious layouts
- All utilities support fractional values (0.5, 1.5, 2.5)

## Installation
```bash
pnpm add tw-blocks
```

## Basic Usage
```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "tw-blocks";
```

## Available Classes

### Spacing (p-*, m-*, gap-*)
- Tab scale: tab-0, tab-0.5, tab-1, tab-1.5, tab-2, tab-2.5, tab-3, tab-4, tab-5, tab-6, tab-8, tab-10, tab-12, tab-16, tab-20, tab-24, tab-32
- Block scale: block-0, block-0.5, block-1, block-1.5, block-2, block-2.5, block-3, block-4, block-5, block-6, block-8, block-10, block-12, block-16

### Sizing (w-*, h-*, size-*)
- Use same tab/block values for consistent sizing
- Examples: h-block-1 (32px), w-block-2 (64px), size-block-1

### Border Radius (rounded-*)
- Block radius: rounded-block-0.5, rounded-block-1
- Tab radius: rounded-tab-1, rounded-tab-2, rounded-tab-3, rounded-tab-4

## Example Patterns

### Button
```html
<button class="h-block-1 px-tab-4 rounded-tab-2">Click me</button>
```

### Card
```html
<div class="p-tab-4 rounded-block-0.5">Card content</div>
```

### Input Field
```html
<input class="h-block-1 px-tab-3 rounded-tab-2" />
```

### Header
```html
<header class="h-block-2 px-tab-4">Header content</header>
```

### Sidebar
```html
<aside class="w-[240px] p-tab-3">Sidebar content</aside>
```

## API Format
All documentation available in markdown format.
Request with Accept: text/markdown header.
